title: What is Afterlife?
content: Afterlife is India's first digital succession planning platform. It helps you organise, secure, and deliver your important information, heartfelt messages, and emotions to your chosen ones, exactly when and how you wish. Afterlife is built by AL Experiences and Solutions Pvt. Ltd. The tagline is 'Your friend for Life and Beyond.' Over ₹1.8 trillion lies unclaimed with Indian financial institutions — Afterlife exists to solve this problem by helping families plan ahead.

title: Afterlife Core Features Overview
content: Afterlife has four core features: 1) Digital Vault — Add, organise, assign, and deliver. Secure all your important information and documents in one place. You can assign specific documents and information to specific people. 2) Digital Will — Your succession at your fingertips. Plan and re-plan your succession with ease. Create your will digitally in minutes. 3) Organ Pledge — Live beyond life. Pledge your organs so that as you complete your journey, you help others continue theirs. 4) Claim Assistance — A helping hand. Ensures a hassle-free process for succession, counselling, claim assistance and more. 5) Afterlife Messages — Leave nothing unsaid. Let your messages stay here with your loved ones, even after you. You can write heartfelt messages, record videos, and schedule them for future delivery.

title: Digital Vault Feature
content: The Digital Vault in Afterlife lets you organise, assign, and deliver your important information securely. You can store financial information (bank accounts, investments, insurance policies, fixed deposits), legal documents, property papers, passwords, and any other sensitive information. Each item in the vault can be assigned to specific Trusted Contacts (Buddies or Secretkeepers) who will receive access only when needed. The vault uses end-to-end encryption and geo-redundant storage to keep your data safe. Think of it as a secure digital locker that ensures your family can find everything they need, without the usual struggle of tracking down scattered documents and accounts.

title: Digital Will Feature
content: Afterlife's Digital Will feature allows you to create and manage your succession plan digitally. You can plan and re-plan your succession with ease — it takes just minutes to set up. The Digital Will lets you specify who gets what, assign beneficiaries to specific assets, and update your will anytime as your circumstances change. This is not a legally registered will but a comprehensive succession planning document that gives your family clear guidance on your wishes. For legal will registration, you would need to follow the standard legal process, but the Digital Will ensures nothing is left ambiguous.

title: Organ Pledge Feature
content: The Organ Pledge feature in Afterlife allows you to pledge your organs so that when your journey ends, you can help others continue theirs. This is a noble way to live beyond life. The feature makes the otherwise complex organ donation pledge process very convenient and accessible directly from the app.

title: Claim Assistance Feature
content: Afterlife's Claim Assistance provides a helping hand to your loved ones when they need it most. It ensures a hassle-free process for succession, counselling, and claim assistance. When a family member needs to claim insurance, access bank accounts, transfer property, or handle any financial succession matter, Afterlife's claim assistance service guides them through the process step by step. This is available as a pay-as-you-use ancillary service.

Whether it is a birthday wish for your grandchild years from now, a message of comfort for your spouse, or important instructions for your family — your words stay here with your loved ones, even after you. title: Security and Data Protection
content: Afterlife takes security extremely seriously. Here are the key security measures: 1) One User, One KYC, One Device — your account is tied to a single verified identity and device. 2) Passkey-enabled secure login with a six-digit PIN — password-less, phishing-resistant authentication. 3) End-to-End Encryption (E2EE) — all files and messages are encrypted on your device before transmission and remain encrypted until the recipient accesses them. 4) Geo-Redundant Storage (GRS) — encrypted data is replicated across geographically distant locations for disaster recovery. 5) Digital signatures are applied to all files and messages, ensuring they remain unaltered. 6) Comprehensive logging and monitoring — all access events are logged in an encrypted, tamper-proof audit trail. 7) ISO-certified security standards. 8) Aadhaar-based KYC verification via DigiLocker integration. All data is stored within India through Microsoft Azure.

title: Nominee vs Beneficiary — What Most People Get Wrong
content: A common misconception in India is that naming a nominee means they automatically inherit your assets. In reality, a nominee is legally only a custodian or trustee — like a 'postman' for your wealth. The nominee holds the asset temporarily until it is distributed to the legal heirs. If there is a dispute between the nominee and the legal heirs, the legal heirs typically prevail in court. This is why naming a nominee is only half the job — a Will is what completes it. A simple Will avoids 90% of family disputes and cuts through months of banking and legal processes. Afterlife helps you understand this distinction and plan accordingly with both trusted contacts and a Digital Will.

title: Will Writing in India — Why It Matters
content: 63% of succession cases in Indian courts stem from the absence of a Will. Over 3 crore cases are still pending in courts related to succession disputes. In western countries, over 70% of the population above 40 years of age has a will, compared to less than 20% in India. You do not need a lawyer to write a valid Will in India — that is a myth. Afterlife's Digital Will feature lets you create and update your will in minutes from your phone. While the Digital Will is a comprehensive succession planning document, for legal registration you would follow the standard legal process. Having a clear Will gives your family direction and avoids disputes, delays, and confusion.

title: Myths and Facts About Succession in India
content: Here are common myths and facts about succession planning in India that every family should know: MYTH: 'You need a lawyer to write a valid Will in India.' FACT: You do not need a lawyer — anyone can write a valid will. FACT: 'Unclaimed deposits in India exceed ₹1.5 lakh crore.' This is confirmed by multiple sources. MYTH: 'A Nominee automatically becomes the legal owner of your assets.' In reality, a nominee is legally just a custodian or trustee — like a 'postman' for your wealth. MYTH: 'If you have a joint account, your family automatically gets the money.' This is not always true and depends on the type of joint holding. FACT: 'Without a Will, your assets are distributed as per the Indian Succession Act.' This means the court decides, not your family. A simple Will avoids 90% of family disputes and cuts through months of banking and legal processes. Naming a nominee is only half the job — a Will is what completes it.
